Done. The merge succeeded on the first execution.

- `out/T4/solution.py` loads the two base shards via the index, checks that all three checkpoints share the same 114 names, and verifies every non-MLP tensor is bit-identical across base, ft1 and ft2 before merging.
- Each of the 48 MLP tensors is computed as base plus 0.4 times each task vector, with both task vectors taken against the unmodified base dict. All other tensors are copied from the base unchanged.
- The script asserts 48 merged and 114 output tensors, writes `out/T4/model.safetensors`, then reloads it and re-checks the unchanged tensors.
- `out/T4/REPORT.md` contains the self-report: one execution, no failures.
